QuestInfo.name: Halfhearted Thanks
QuestInfo.0: Your big gift was raw animal liver. Supposedly it's a delicacy for the foxes, but you sure don't see it that way. At least thank them for the gesture.
QuestInfo.1: It was easily the strangest and most awkward gift you've ever gotten, but you should still thank the townsfolk.
QuestInfo.2: You thanked the townsfolk, but they still seem pretty cold. Did they figure out you didn't eat your gift?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1200\r\nCan proceed to It's the Gift that Counts

speech.0: So, did you like your gift? You must have, since I don't see any left! Boy, I bet it was soooooo good. SO GOOD.

Raw liver is a very rare treat for us. Special occasions only. I just want to make sure you know how lucky you are, okay? You really should appreciate the gesture. Like, a lot. Why, you might even be compelled to repay the favor, hmm?
The fresher the liver, the better the taste. The taste changes quickly, you see. And that liver we got for you... Let me tell you, it was the freshest I've ever seen. THE freshest!
You've come to thank me? Are you really thankful? I don't know... Those hands are awfully empty for someone so thankful. Yes, well, I've got a TON of chores to do. So scoot.

0.msg: I guess I should thank them at least. The foxes gave me their best gift... I'll just say I ate it.

yes.0: Ahh, but what if they figure out that I didn't eat it? Hmm. ...Wait, why am I so hung up on this?

no.0: Well, maybe halfhearted thanks isn't good either...

1.0: Aha, you went around town to thank everyone? Good on you.

default.0: You got the gift from the townsfolk, right? Oh, you're on your way to thank them? What a sweetheart you are!
